create.name: Bess Matassa
create.bio:
Working out of New York, Bess Matassa reads charts and cards for clients and describes herself, with some relish, as a professional witch. Under the name The Star Parlor she combines astrology, tarot and a mediumistic sense of guidance, and her tone is poetic and playful while staying practical about choices people face. She holds a doctorate and has advised brands and institutions on astrology, among them Teen Vogue, Almay and the Rubin Museum of Art, and she has devised unusual ways into the subject, such as walking tours built around a person's birth chart and classes in blending zodiac-inspired perfume.

Her books and decks are aimed at people who want to use these tools themselves: The Tarot Almanac pairs the cards with the turning of the zodiac through the year, NYC Tarot (illustrated by Clara Kirkpatrick) reimagines the deck through the city's landmarks, and she wrote the Leo and Virgo volumes of the Zodiac Signs series and co-created The Numinous Astro Deck with Ruby Warrington. Star Charting, a short book in Duke University Press's Practices series, followed in 2026. Clients book readings with her over Zoom, from a half-hour taster to partnership charts, and she also mentors students one to one in learning astrology and tarot.

books.title: The Tarot Almanac: A Seasonal Guide to Divining with Your Cards
books.author: Bess Matassa
books.description: A year-round workbook that ties each card of the tarot to the sun's passage through the zodiac signs. Month by month it offers spreads, prompts and simple rituals for getting to know a deck.

books.title: NYC Tarot: Divination from the Greatest City on Earth
books.author: Bess Matassa
books.description: A 78-card tarot deck and guidebook in which the traditional cards are drawn through New York landmarks, foods and characters. Illustrated by Clara Kirkpatrick, with text by Bess Matassa.

books.title: Zodiac Signs: Leo
books.author: Bess Matassa
books.description: A pocket guide to the sign of Leo in a series written by working astrologers. It looks at how the sign shows up through childhood, work, friendship and love.

books.title: Zodiac Signs: Virgo
books.author: Bess Matassa
books.description: Her companion volume on Virgo in the same sign-by-sign series. It follows the sign through the stages and relationships of a life.

books.title: The Numinous Astro Deck
books.author: Ruby Warrington, Bess Matassa
books.description: A 45-card learning deck covering the signs, houses, planets and aspects, with a companion book on reading birth charts. Created with Ruby Warrington of The Numinous.

books.title: Star Charting
books.author: Bess Matassa
books.description: A short book in Duke University Press's Practices series that treats the twelve signs as a poetic, everyday practice. It is written for curious readers rather than as a technical chart manual.

courses.title: Astro + Tarot Reading
courses.description: A sixty-minute Zoom session reading the main themes of your birth chart and the energies of the coming year, followed by a tarot spread on a question you choose.

courses.title: Mini Mystic Reading
courses.description: A half-hour taster session on Zoom with a tarot spread for the present moment, a look at your astrological archetypes and a short connection with your guides.

courses.title: Partnership Reading
courses.description: A 75-minute session on the shared chart of two people, whether partners, friends, relatives or colleagues, looking at what the relationship is for and how it can grow, with a tarot spread on a chosen theme.

courses.title: Astrological Tour
courses.description: A full chart and tarot reading combined with a self-guided tour of places chosen to bring your chart's energies to life. It is designed mainly around New York City but can be adapted to other places.

courses.title: Mystical Mentorship
courses.description: One-to-one programmes of four, eight or twelve sessions for people who want to learn astrology and tarot in a structured but personal way.
